summary.text: Kathleen A. Riebe is a Democratic member of the Utah Senate representing District 15 in Salt Lake County and has served since January 2019. Her official legislative profile lists her profession as educational technology teacher.

paragraphs.text: Riebe holds a B.S. in elementary education and sociology from Hofstra University and a master's degree in education from Utah State University.
She sits on the Executive Appropriations Committee and the Senate Education Committee.
